description: r0b0tlab's EXL3 SAGE quantization of zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash at about 2.25 bits per weight (320B total, about 18B active mixture of experts, 98.5 GB, mul1 codebook, mixed K3/K4 tiles) for ExLlamaV3 and the sglang-exl3 plugin; quantization_config.json carries the per-tensor manifest the plugin reads. The pack also carries the BF16 vision tower (347 tensors); the SGLang recipe serves text only.
